description: This PHP source file defines a class for managing maintenance statistics update tasks in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods to determine when to update intermediate and final statistics tables based on last run times and logged delivery data.

classes.name: OX_Maintenance_Statistics_Task_SetUpdateRequirements
classes.description: A class that determines whether maintenance statistics need to be updated during an MSE run, based on last update times and delivery data.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method that checks last update times, compares with current time, and sets flags for updating intermediate and final statistics tables.

methods.name: _getMaintenanceStatisticsLastRunInfo
methods.description: Private method to retrieve the last time maintenance statistics were run for a given update type from the database.

methods.name: _getEarliestLoggedDeliveryData
methods.description: Private method to find the earliest logged delivery data date from deliveryLog components, used to initialize stats for new installations.
